_readme: Hand-curated and generated New York 2026 coverage evidence. Every rule must quote its source document verbatim (whitespace-insensitive). scratch/build_ri_verified_rules.py refuses to build if any excerpt is not found in the cited document or if a document's SHA-256 changed. Plans without rules show as 'benefits under review'.
